source: Explicit user instruction: 私の個人のアカウントから投稿するのは禁止します
objective: Qualified business inquiries, paid adoption, and revenue for AI Meeting
rules: Publish AI Meeting promotions only from the verified FORIFOR apps business identities below, or an explicitly authorized replacement. User-prohibited personal-profile publishing remains disallowed.
Never treat the currently signed-in identity, display name alone, or an existing unrelated channel as an approved publisher.
Confirm the selected publishing identity and destinations immediately before submission; stop if ambiguous.
Do not publish to a personal profile, invite the user's personal contacts, or crosspost to a personal destination.
A Facebook administrator login is distinct from the Page publishing identity; no posting from the administrator's personal profile.
Do not convert the user's existing personal TikTok profile into the product account.
Do not restart tester recruitment or use stars and view counts as evidence of customers or revenue.

tiktok.evidence: User completed login after the dedicated-account setup request. Authenticated Studio and public profile show @foriforapps, an apps-development brand with product demo content, not an individual personal identity.

facebook.evidence: Page management navigation, IT company category, Business Suite Page asset, and composer author foriforapps all observed. Personal profile was not used to publish.

automation.enforcement: Operational instruction only; no publishing service or technical guard has been implemented.
automation.requirement_before_enabling: Restrict the publisher to verified product account/Page IDs and exclude personal-profile destinations.

scope_note: The logged-in identities are shared FORIFOR app-promotion channels, including Genie. They were not renamed, repurposed, or stripped of other projects. AI Meeting posts concern business inquiries, not testers.
